Store internals monitoring: service availability (database, mail, disk, queues, cache), checkout prerequisites, basic security hygiene and package version history. Results are available in the Calmfox Watch panel.

No account yet, start the Free plan
The account is created right away: availability of the store, the SSL certificate and the state of its services. No password, you sign in with a link sent by e-mail.

I already have an account, connect through the panel
You will go to %panel%, sign in or create an account, pick an organisation, and we will come back here with the key and connect the store. The store does not have to exist in the panel beforehand.
Connect through %panel%
This screen runs under a different address than the store domain reported to the monitoring (%domain%), so the panel would reject the return with the key. Pair with the installation key instead.

The Free plan, and what a higher tier adds
On Free we watch store availability, the certificate and the state of services. Higher plans add what Free does not cover:
probes every 30 to 60 seconds instead of every 5 minutes, so an outage shows up at once, not a quarter of an hour later
page review: truncated content, 404s and broken links, before a customer notices them
monitoring of chosen pages and of the checkout path, not only the home page
alerts by SMS, messenger and mobile app, with no monthly cap
periodic reports and a longer event history
